Senior Full-Stack Engineer

About the Role:
We are seeking an experienced Full-Stack Engineer to architect and scale our cloud platform.

Key Responsibilities:
- Build real-time web applications using React, Next.js, and TypeScript.
- Design scalable backend microservices and RESTful APIs using Node.js and Express.
- Optimize MongoDB queries and data pipelines for high-throughput distributed systems.
- Mentor junior and mid-level software engineers through code reviews and technical design sessions.

Requirements (Must Have):
- 5+ years of experience with React and TypeScript.
- Strong hands-on proficiency with Node.js, Express, and REST APIs.
- Production database experience with MongoDB and Redis.
- Proven track record mentoring junior engineers and leading design reviews.

Nice to Have (Bonus):
- Experience with Docker, Kubernetes, and AWS deployment.
- Familiarity with CI/CD automation using GitHub Actions.
- Background in financial technology or high-reliability systems.
